memberdef.argsstring: (EHContGuardCatchret, "EHContGuardCatchret", "Insert symbols at valid catchret targets for /guard:ehcont", false, false) FunctionPass *llvm
memberdef.name: INITIALIZE_PASS

param.type: "Insert symbols at valid catchret targets for /guard:ehcont"

briefdescription.para: This file contains a machine function pass to insert a symbol before each valid catchret target and store this in the MachineFunction's CatchRetTargets vector.

detaileddescription.para: This will be used to emit the table of valid targets used by EHCont Guard.
